crm_notes: Buyer org: Stonegate Payments (core card processing + risk); extremely sensitive PII/transactional data.
They want Redwood Private in VPC with SIEM export to their Splunk cluster and long-term retention for audit (7 years preferred by compliance team).
Primary ask on call: exact log schema + sample payloads for SIEM ingest. Security says 'no black box logs' — need field-level mapping.

SE note: will need to show that audit logs include request metadata: api_key_id, model_id/version, timestamp, caller_ip, token_counts, prompt_hash (not raw prompt for PII), response_status, inference_node_id.
They require logs to be writable to customer-managed S3 in their account OR push via syslog/CEF to Splunk forwarder. Also want a Kafka/HTTPS collector option for real-time SIEM correlation.
Retention ask: default platform retention 90d is insufficient. Options requested: 1 year, 3 years, and 7 years — must document storage and egress costs for each tier.
KMS: BYOK via AWS KMS and support for HSM-backed CMKs. Customer legal wants proof of key separation for logs vs payloads; propose envelope encryption and separate key policies.
Access controls: detailed RBAC logs (who accessed which customer logs), and an audit trail for console/API actions (create/delete/deploy).
Quote from Head of Security: 'We need deterministic log format we can map to our detection engineering playbooks; duplicates and partial records will be a blocker.'
Procurement: internal budget earmarked, but final sign-off contingent on security sign-off + SLA for Private deployment.
"Do not store full prompts in logs" is repeated across legal & security — prefer prompt hashes + metadata for debugging.
Asked for sample SIEM mapping doc; Aisha to deliver by 2024-11-12.
requirements_summary: SIEM export: support for Splunk (HTTP Event Collector + syslog forwarder), Elastic ingest (JSONL), IBM QRadar (CEF/syslog).

Log formats: JSON Lines (primary), CEF and RFC5424 for syslog pipelines. Need field names and types: timestamp, tenant_id, api_key_id, user_id (hashed), endpoint, model_version, request_tokens, response_tokens, latency_ms, status_code, node_id, region, prompt_hash.
Access logs: console/API administrative actions (create/deploy/rollback/role changes) with actor, ip, user-agent, change_delta and request_id.
Retention: configurable per-tenant; requested policies: 1y / 3y / 7y. Provide storage cost estimates and recommended life-cycle rules (S3 INTELLIGENT_TIERING -> Glacier for >1y).
Data residency: logs must be stored and delivered from customer's preferred region (us-east-1 or eu-west-1). If exporting out, need explicit legal justification and DPA addendum.
KMS integration: BYOK support with AWS KMS CMKs and HSM-backed key attestations. Separate key for log export encryption. Support key rotation with zero-downtime rewrap.
Integrity: signed log bundles (daily) and ability to provide hash-chain proofs for tamper-evidence on request.
Latency/throughput: SIEM export must handle burst of 2k TPS of audit events across fleet; propose batching with backpressure and guaranteed-at-least-once delivery semantics.
Schema stability: need versioned schema and changelog; notify customers 30 days before breaking changes.
Operational: playbook for incident: reingest window, replay tool, retention purge request handling, and access remediation audit trail.
Monitoring: per-tenant export success metrics, failed deliveries, queue depth, and alerting hooks into customer's PagerDuty.
Legal: redact or omit raw prompt text by default; provide opt-in debug logs under stricter controls with time-limited access and audit gating.
technical_notes: Preferred SIEM connectors: Splunk HEC (token + TLS), syslog-ng to forwarder, Kafka topic (SSL + mTLS) for internal streaming pipeline.
Example event: {timestamp, tenant_id, api_key_id, model_version, prompt_hash, request_tokens, response_tokens, latency_ms, node_id, region, outcome} — provide sample JSON soon.
Need to confirm whether customer expects log enrichment (mapping user IDs to internal directory) or will do enrichment on SIEM side.
Requested: ability to filter PII at log emit time (drop/replace specific fields) and catalog of all fields that may contain PII.
Bandwidth note: customer has 100Mbps egress cap from VPC to SIEM; discuss batching and backpressure SLAs to avoid export drop.
Ask from infra: proof-of-concept to forward 24h of logs to customer's Splunk test index (demo env).
Support ticket INF-1124 opened for sample log payloads and schema doc. SEC-2209 tracks legal KMS questions.
